policy: Screen all three routes on first 10 fixed development photos. Keep Luna as quality anchor and the better cheap route (screen correct count, then published input+0.15output price). Complete remaining 50 photos and 30 texts on each finalist. Choose cheapest measured photo+text route meeting >=55/60 photos, >=37/40 heldout, 30/30 texts, zero errors. No heldout prompt tuning. Then up to three fixed-stratum locator smoke cases on the chosen route. Max199 planned generations, one spare; no retries. Two consecutive errors stop that candidate batch; unstarted cases remain unverified and cannot qualify.
